highlights.title: No more run line posing as reasoning
highlights.text: A reply made through a CLI used to show its "Executed via … CLI" line as the bot's reasoning. It's gone now. Real reasoning still shows, in older messages too.

highlights.title: Details shows the effort
highlights.text: Open Details on a CLI reply and Ran on now ends with the effort it ran at, for example "· medium effort".

fixes: After a usage limit or its cap, the idea jar no longer starts one more take a few minutes later.
Details' Ran on reads "on this machine" instead of "on the This machine account".
Go to the approval's amber flash now fits the approval card on a wide window.
A finished hand-off keeps the chat busy until its lead takes over, so the lead never reviews it twice.
Go to the approval, pressed from the keyboard, lands on the approval card, and only one pointer to it shows.
